comment: Canonical WIRE layout of the multiplayer Y.Doc (schema §1). `roots` maps each logical role to the Y.Doc ROOT TYPE NAME as it is spelled inside an encoded Yjs update; `reserved_node_keys` names the per-node keys the doc owns. These strings are a cross-implementation contract, not an internal detail: two replicas that disagree about them cannot exchange a document, because a follower forking from the bootstrap snapshot (KA-10) resolves roots by name. Renaming any of them is a layout break under KA-11 and requires a SCHEMA_VERSION bump, a migrate() step, and a matching edit to docs/multiplayer-schema.md §1 and docs/INVARIANTS.md KA-3 — never a silent rename. A second implementation should read this file rather than transcribing the names.
